# Sociapi Society

> Sociapi Society is a student-led AI and technology community connecting university students through campus chapters, practical learning, events, and student leadership in Pakistan.

- Website: https://sociapis.vercel.app/
- About: https://sociapis.vercel.app/about
- University chapters: https://sociapis.vercel.app/chapters
- Events and event reports: https://sociapis.vercel.app/events
- Opportunities: https://sociapis.vercel.app/opportunities
- Partnership information: https://sociapis.vercel.app/partner-with-us
- Contact: https://sociapis.vercel.app/contact

Chapter pages describe Sociapi's student-led campus communities. They do not by themselves assert university endorsement or formal affiliation.
